notificationsReady.title: Notifications
notificationsReady.subtitle: Operational follow-up for your accessible branches.
notificationsReady.onlineRequired: Go online with refreshed access to open workflows or change read state. Cached follow-ups may no longer apply.
notificationsReady.failed: Notifications could not be refreshed or saved. Retry refresh; the last snapshot may be stale.
notificationsReady.disabled: In-app notifications are off. History remains available. Enable them in Settings to receive future follow-ups.
notificationsReady.timing: Follow-ups refresh when navigating, returning to the app, reconnecting, and every minute while the app is active. They are last-checked conditions, not live monitoring.
notificationsReady.invitationExpired: Invitation expired: review or replace it in Staff.

OUT_OF_STOCK.title: Out of sellable stock
OUT_OF_STOCK.body: Review inventory and replenish eligible stock.

EXPIRY_ALERT.title: Expiry follow-up
EXPIRY_ALERT.body: Review the batch in the expiry worklist.

BATCH_ATTENTION.title: Batch requires attention
BATCH_ATTENTION.body: Review quarantined or recalled stock and its next action.

PURCHASE_FOLLOWUP.title: Purchase awaiting receipt
PURCHASE_FOLLOWUP.body: Review the order and its remaining receipt.

TRANSFER_FOLLOWUP.title: Transfer requires action
TRANSFER_FOLLOWUP.body: Open the transfer for the next authorized step.

COUNT_FOLLOWUP.title: Physical count in progress
COUNT_FOLLOWUP.body: Complete or review the open physical count.

INVITATION_FOLLOWUP.title: Staff invitation follow-up
INVITATION_FOLLOWUP.body: Review the pending invitation in Staff. No external delivery is implied.

IMPORT_FAILED.title: Import needs review
IMPORT_FAILED.body: Review failed import rows in Operations before retrying.

notificationsReady.notLoaded: No synchronized notifications are available. Go online and refresh.
